channels.label: Channel-edge pattern
channels.bestTide: Prioritize moving water; work the edge and current seam rather than the mapped centerline.
channels.approach: Start at first light in summer. Cast along depth transitions and let the current carry the presentation past ambush water.
channels.baits: Live shrimp near structure; soft-bodied jigs or paddle-tails; spoons or topwater for actively feeding trout and reds.

creek_mouths.label: Tidal-drain and creek-mouth pattern
creek_mouths.bestTide: Fish moving water. Incoming water can push fish onto the adjacent flat; outgoing water can concentrate bait leaving the marsh.
creek_mouths.approach: Cover the current seam and bottom transition without blocking the narrow drain. Look for bait movement, wakes, or diving birds.
creek_mouths.baits: Live shrimp under a popping cork for reds and trout; a shrimp or soft jig near bottom for flounder; shrimp or fiddler crab near hard structure for sheepshead.

shoreline_points.label: Marsh-point pattern
shoreline_points.bestTide: Use current direction to choose the down-current side where bait is swept past the point.
shoreline_points.approach: Stay off the point and cast along both shoreline edges. Watch for mullet, bait sprays, wakes, and feeding birds before committing.
shoreline_points.baits: Popping-cork shrimp, soft-bodied jigs or paddle-tails, spoons, and low-light topwater.

sand_holes.label: Visible-shoal edge pattern
sand_holes.bestTide: Work the edge when water is moving; avoid assuming the pale area is sand or safe depth until field checked.
sand_holes.approach: Fish the color-change perimeter, not the unverified shallow interior. Use a slow presentation near bottom for flounder.
sand_holes.baits: Soft jig or paddle-tail, live shrimp, spoon, or a float-rigged bait worked above adjacent grass.

fishing_locations.label: Regional estuary pattern
fishing_locations.bestTide: Use the mapped habitat profile where available and prioritize moving water.
fishing_locations.approach: Treat the waypoint as visually reviewed structure, not a verified fishing spot. Confirm depth, bottom, and safe access on the water.
fishing_locations.baits: Match the linked habitat profile and current regional report; live shrimp and soft-bodied jigs are the broadest starting choices.
